images.prompt: Premium editorial illustration, high-end tech magazine style: two identical parallel suspension bridges spanning a dark chasm at night — the near bridge alive with flowing streams of glowing traffic; the twin backup bridge beside it looks flawless from a distance, but a small engineer walking it with a lantern has just discovered its far end stops short of the cliff, a thin gap hidden in the fog. Bought twice, proven once. Deep dark navy (#161a45) dominant palette, soft cream (#F4EFE3) highlights, thin red (#eb2027) accent outlining the hidden gap only — no green, no purple, no rainbow palettes. No readable text, letters, or numbers anywhere. Cinematic moody lighting, minimalist composition.
